name: Story: Night Market
description: Full text with numbers and symbols.
fixedText: At 6:05 PM, the night market lit up, and Mina wrote "List #3" on her wrist. She bought 2 pies for $7.50, paid with a card, and got a receipt that read: TAX=8%. A small cat followed her, jumping over crates marked [A-12] and (B-4). "Stay close," she said; the bell chimed, and the vendor nodded.

name: Story: Signal Log
description: Full text with mixed case and operators.
fixedText: The radio log started with: "Day 19, 04:17 @ Ridge Station." We tested a new antenna, toggled switch A/B, and the meter jumped from 0.9 to 1.3. The old map had notes like "north-3" and "west+2", but the signal only stabilized when we set gain=7 and the lamp blinked 3 times.

name: Story: Clockwork Letter
description: Full text with punctuation and math.
fixedText: In the attic, a folded letter said: "Meet me at Gate 5 - bring the brass key." Jae checked the clock (11:02) and scribbled 2+2=4 on the envelope. The note smelled of oil & smoke, and a tiny gear with 8 teeth fell onto the table.

name: Story: Workshop Report
description: Full text with symbols, units, and caps.
fixedText: Report 07: The prototype "Vega" failed test #42. We saw a 3.14 cm crack, a 12% voltage drop, and a fuse marked 10A/250V. Still, the crew cheered when the reboot finished in 9.8s; the console flashed OK>READY and the room went quiet.
